title: The Diatessaron (Section 51)
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > The Diatessaron (Tatian) > Section 51

paragraphs.text: 1 [Arabic, p. 192] {{BIBLE:joh 19:13}} And when Pilate heard this saying, he took Jesus out, and sat on the tribune in the place which was called the pavement of stones, but in the Hebrew 2 called Gabbatha. {{BIBLE:joh 19:14}} And that day was the Friday of the passover: and it had reached 3 about the sixth hour. {{BIBLE:joh 19:15}} And he said to the Jews, Behold, your King! And they cried out, Take him, take him, crucify him, crucify him. Pilate said unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests said unto him, We have no king except 4 Cæsar. {{BIBLE:mat 27:24}} And Pilate, when he saw it, and he was gaining nothing, but the tumult was increasing, took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, and said, I 5 am innocent of the blood of this innocent man: you shall know. {{BIBLE:mat 27:25}} And all the people 6 answered and said, His blood be on us, and on our children. {{BIBLE:joh 19:16}} Then Pilate commanded to grant them their request; and delivered up Jesus to be crucified, according to their wish.

7 {{BIBLE:mat 27:3}} Then Judas the betrayer, when he saw Jesus wronged, went and returned the 8 thirty pieces of money to the chief priests and the elders, {{BIBLE:mat 27:4}} and said, I have sinned in my betraying innocent blood. And they said unto him, And we, what must we do? 9 know thou. {{BIBLE:mat 27:5}} And he threw down the money in the temple, and departed; and he 10 went away and hanged himself. {{BIBLE:mat 27:6}} And the chief priests took the money, and said, We have not authority to cast it into the place of the offering, for it is the price 11 of blood. {{BIBLE:mat 27:7}} And they took counsel, and bought with it the plain of the potter, for 12 the burial of strangers. {{BIBLE:mat 27:8}} Therefore that plain was called, The field of blood, unto 13 [Arabic, p. 193] this day. {{BIBLE:mat 27:9}} Therein was fulfilled the saying in the prophet which said, I took thirty pieces of money, the price of the precious one, which was fixed 14 by the children of Israel; {{BIBLE:mat 27:10}} and I paid them for the plain of the potter, as the Lord commanded me.

15 And the Jews took Jesus, and went away to crucify him. And when he bare his 16 cross and went out, they stripped him of those purple and scarlet garments which he 17 had on, and put on him his own garments. And while they were going with him, they found a man, a Cyrenian, coming from the country, named Simon, the father of Alexander and Rufus: {{BIBLE:mat 27:32}} and they compelled this man to bear the cross of Jesus. 18 {{BIBLE:luk 23:26}} And they took the cross and laid it upon him, that he might bear it, and come after Jesus; and Jesus went, and his cross behind him.

19 {{BIBLE:luk 23:27}} And there followed him much people, and women which were lamenting and 20 raving. {{BIBLE:luk 23:28}} But Jesus turned unto them and said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not 21 for me: weep for yourselves, and for your children. {{BIBLE:luk 23:29}} Days are coming, when they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that bare not, and the breasts 22 that gave not suck. {{BIBLE:luk 23:30}} Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and 23 to the hills, Cover us. {{BIBLE:luk 23:31}} For if they do so in the green tree, what shall be in the dry?
24 {{BIBLE:luk 23:32}} And they brought with Jesus two others of the malefactors, to be put to death.

25 And when they came unto a certain place called The skull, and called in the Hebrew Golgotha, they crucified him there: {{BIBLE:luk 23:33}} they crucified with him these two 26 malefactors, one on his right, and the other on his left. {{BIBLE:mar 15:28}} And the scripture was 27 [Arabic, p. 194] fulfilled, which says, He was numbered with the transgressors. {{BIBLE:mar 15:23}} And they gave him to drink wine and myrrh, and vinegar which had been mixed with the myrrh; and he tasted, and would not drink; and he received it not.

28 {{BIBLE:joh 19:23}} And the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and cast lots for them in four parts, to every party of the soldiers a part; and his tunic was 29 without sewing, from the top woven throughout. {{BIBLE:joh 19:24}} And they said one to another, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: and the scripture was fulfilled, which says,

They divided my garments among them,
And cast the lot for my vesture.

30, 31 {{BIBLE:mat 27:36}} This the soldiers did. And they sat and guarded him there. {{BIBLE:joh 19:19}} And Pilate wrote on a tablet the cause of his death, and put it on the wood of the cross above his head. {{BIBLE:mat 27:37}} And there was written upon it thus: This is Jesus the Nazarene, the King of the 32 Jews. {{BIBLE:joh 19:20}} And this tablet read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city: and it was written in Hebrew and Greek and Latin. 33 {{BIBLE:joh 19:21}} And the chief priests said unto Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but, He it is 34 that said, I am the King of the Jews. {{BIBLE:joh 19:22}} Pilate said unto them, What has been 35 written has been written. And the people were standing beholding; and they 36 that passed by were reviling him, and shaking their heads, and saying, You who destroys the temple, and builds it in three days, {{BIBLE:mat 27:40}} save yourself if you are the Son 37 of God, and come down from the cross. {{BIBLE:mat 27:41}} And in like manner the chief priests and the [Arabic, p. 195] scribes and the elders and the Pharisees derided him, and laughed one with 38, 39 another, and said, {{BIBLE:mat 27:42}} The saviour of others cannot save himself. If he is the Messiah, the chosen of God, and the King of Israel, let him come down now from the 40 cross, that we may see, and believe in him. {{BIBLE:mat 27:43}} He that relies on God— let him deliver him 41 now, if he is pleased with him: for he said, I am the Son of God. {{BIBLE:luk 23:36}} And the soldiers 42 also scoffed at him in that they came near unto him, {{BIBLE:luk 23:37}} and brought him vinegar, and 43 said unto him, If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself. {{BIBLE:mat 27:44}} And likewise the two robbers also that were crucified with him reproached him.

44 {{BIBLE:luk 23:39}} And one of those two malefactors who were crucified with him reviled him, and 45 said, If you are the Messiah, save yourself, and save us also. {{BIBLE:luk 23:40}} But his comrade rebuked him, and said, Do you not even fear God, being yourself also in this 46 condemnation? {{BIBLE:luk 23:41}} And we with justice, and as we deserved, and according to our deed, have we been rewarded: but this man has not done anything unlawful. 47 {{BIBLE:luk 23:42}} And he said unto Jesus, Remember me, my Lord, when you come in your kingdom. 48 {{BIBLE:luk 23:43}} Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto you, Today shall you be with me in Paradise.

49 {{BIBLE:joh 19:25}} And there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, 50 Mary that was related to Clopas, and Mary Magdalene. {{BIBLE:joh 19:26}} And Jesus saw his mother, and that disciple whom he loved standing by; and he said to his mother, 51 Woman, behold, your son! {{BIBLE:joh 19:27}} And he said to that disciple, Behold, your mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto him self.

52 [Arabic, p. 196] And from the sixth hour darkness was on all the land unto the ninth 53 hour, and the sun became dark. And at the ninth hour Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and said, Yail, Yaili, why have you forsaken me? Which is, My 54 God, my God, why have you forsaken me? {{BIBLE:mat 27:47}} And some of those that stood there, when they heard, said, This man called Elijah.

source_note: Source. Translated by Hope W. Hogg. From Ante-Nicene Fathers, Vol. 9. Edited by Allan Menzies. (Buffalo, NY: Christian Literature Publishing Co., 1896.) Revised and edited for New Advent by Kevin Knight. <http://www.newadvent.org/fathers/100251.htm>.
